services.name: Flood Zone Determination Letter
services.description: Official Township of Edison Flood Zone Determination Letter Request Form. Used by property owners, buyers, and lenders to obtain formal written determination from the Division of Engineering regarding whether a property is located in a FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area (SFHA).
required_documents: Completed Flood Zone Determination Letter Request Form
Property street address and exact Tax Map Block and Lot number(s)
$25.00 Flood Letter Fee

submission_routing.desk: Division of Engineering, Edison Municipal Complex

services.name: Permit Flow Chart to Help Determine What Permit is Needed
services.description: Official Township of Edison Permit Flow Charts to help determine what municipal permit is needed for property projects. Outlines decision trees for Road Opening, Tree Removal, Soil Importation/Exportation, and Site Improvement Permits.

submission_routing.desk: Division of Engineering, Edison Municipal Complex

services.name: Requirements for Plot Grading Plans – Minor Development
services.description: Mandatory engineering requirements for plot grading plans on minor developments (new dwellings, additions, in-ground pools, retaining walls, or projects disturbing 1,250+ sq.ft. or adding 500+ sq.ft. impervious coverage).
services.fee_info: Engineering review fee plus 5% construction cost inspection escrow
required_documents: Three (3) sealed plan sets prepared by a NJ licensed Professional Engineer or Land Surveyor
Certified boundary survey overlay with existing/proposed contours and spot elevations
On-site stormwater infiltration calculations (seepage pits designed per Title 34)
Soil erosion and sediment control measures
Site Improvement Permit (SIP) application and approved Zoning Permit

submission_routing.desk: Division of Engineering, Edison Municipal Complex

services.name: Requirements for Plot Grading Plans – Minor Development / Soil Exportation Permit Application
services.description: Municipal permit application and guidelines for exporting soil or removing excess excavated fill from properties in Edison Township (Chapter 31). Required for 10+ cubic yards.
services.fee_info: $50.00 application fee plus performance/restoration bond if required
required_documents: Completed Soil Exportation Permit Application
Topographical survey with cut/fill calculations by NJ licensed surveyor/engineer
Soil erosion and sediment control certification
Designated truck haul route plan

submission_routing.desk: Division of Engineering, Edison Municipal Complex

services.name: Sewer Connection Charge Application
services.description: Application for municipal sanitary sewer main tap-in, fixture unit allocation, and connection charge calculations for new construction or property additions.
services.fee_info: Calculated by plumbing fixture unit schedule per Edison Township municipal code
required_documents: Completed Sewer Connection Charge Application
Plumbing isometric plan and fixture unit count breakdown
Civil engineering site plan showing proposed sanitary lateral sewer connection to municipal main

submission_routing.desk: Edison Sewer Utility Division / Division of Engineering, Municipal Complex

services.name: Site Improvement Permit with Checklist
services.description: Official Edison Township Site Improvement Permit Application and 25-point engineering checklist for site improvements, property disturbance exceeding 1,250 sq.ft., or new impervious coverage exceeding 500 sq.ft.
services.fee_info: Engineering review fee plus 5% construction cost inspection escrow
required_documents: Completed Site Improvement Permit Application and signed 25-point checklist
Approved Zoning Permit and stamped plans
Two (2) signed and sealed engineering site/grading plans prepared by a NJ licensed engineer
Stormwater management infiltration details and soil erosion sediment control measures
Engineering inspection escrow deposit (5% of construction cost)

submission_routing.desk: Division of Engineering, Edison Municipal Complex

services.name: Soil Importation Permit Application
services.description: Official Edison Township application for bringing soil, topsoil, or clean fill onto residential or commercial properties (Chapter 31). Required for 10+ cubic yards.
services.fee_info: $50.00 application fee plus engineering escrow for 10+ cubic yards
required_documents: Completed Soil Importation Permit Application
Certified clean fill laboratory chemical analysis
Property survey showing proposed fill placement and finished grading contours
Designated truck haul route plan

submission_routing.desk: Division of Engineering, Edison Municipal Complex

services.name: Tree Removal Permit Application
services.description: Official Township of Edison Tree Permit Application for tree removal, replacement, and conservation under Municipal Code Chapter 25-8.
services.fee_info: $25.00 for single residential lot (waived for senior citizens aged 62+ with ID; $200 with Board approval / subdivision)
required_documents: Completed Tree Removal Permit Application signed by property owner
Survey or Tax Map sketch showing property boundaries, existing trees with diameter, and removal trees marked with an X
Colored photographs of dead/dying/hazard trees OR certified statement from licensed arborist/forester
Written statement detailing the reason for removal (Township Ordinance 25-8.1a6)
$25 filing fee check payable to 'Township of Edison' or Senior ID (age 62+)
